Reproducible donor-map permutations for saliency controls

Source: R/saliency_controls.R
saliency_donor_assignments.Rd

Produces one-to-one assignments within declared strata, excluding the same stimulus (including alternate versions). A stratum should encode aspect ratio, saliency model/version, and preprocessing. No pixel shuffling is used. These strata do not automatically match concentration; include a declared concentration stratum if the study requires it, and inspect achieved matches after resizing.

Usage

saliency_donor_assignments(
  ids,
  strata,
  stimulus_ids = ids,
  replicates = 10L,
  seed = 1L
)

Arguments

ids

Unique image/map identifiers.

strata

Stratum identifier for each image.

stimulus_ids

Underlying stimulus identifiers; shared values exclude alternate versions of the same stimulus from being each other's donors.

replicates

Number of randomized assignments per stratum.

seed

Local random seed; the caller's random state is restored.

Value

A data frame with target/donor IDs, stimulus IDs, replicate, stratum, seed, eligible donor count, and status. A stratum without a complete valid assignment returns unavailable rows, not an invalid partial permutation.

Details

Randomized matching does not sample all valid permutations uniformly. These assignments support descriptive controls, not calibrated permutation p-values. Repeated assignments are possible, especially in small strata.

Examples

saliency_donor_assignments(c("a", "b", "c"), rep("same-model-square", 3), seed = 3)
#>    target_id target_stimulus_id donor_id donor_stimulus_id           stratum

#> 2          b                  b        c                 c same-model-square
